Expected results

  • Step 7: {Technician-B}'s column reads {Work-order-3}, {Work-order-4}, {Work-order-1}. {Work-order-1} goes to the bottom, even though by customer name it would come first.
  • Step 9: {Technician-B}'s column reads {Work-order-3}, {Work-order-4}, {Work-order-1}, {Work-order-2}. A lead set on the work order page also goes to the bottom.
  • Step 10: {Work-order-5} lands where it was dropped. {Technician-B}'s column reads {Work-order-3}, {Work-order-5}, {Work-order-4}, {Work-order-1}, {Work-order-2}.
  • Steps 11 and 12: Tech View shows the same order in {Technician-B}'s group, and {User-B} sees the same order in both views.

Source — where this behaviour comes from

Epic SV-10043; story SV-10052 (Story 9, Drag to reorder work and technician groups/columns); SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 68 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S9-R14 and S2-R6, read 19 Oct 2026. In version 53 (15 Oct 2026) S2-R6 was reworded to spell out the List's tie-break and to point to S9-R14; the expected results are unchanged. Starting order (customer name A to Z): Review Decisions page 853901313, DR-45 (29 Sep 2026). Source-verified 19 October 2026. Last checked against build v26.40.19-1493c63 (staging) on 10/16/2026. Re-read against PRD version 82 (29 Oct 2026) on 2 Nov 2026: the quoted rules are unchanged.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R14: “A work order that gets a new lead from the lead technician dialog (Assign or Reassign lead technician) or from its detail page goes to the bottom of the new technician’s work, for everyone at the location, in both views. A work order dragged to a technician goes where it is dropped. Removing the lead with the menu’s Unassign action (S11-R9) or on the detail page puts the work order in Unassigned in the initial sort, not at the bottom, so it is not lost behind every other unassigned work order. Going to the bottom applies only to work moved onto a technician. A work order created or split off with a lead keeps the initial sort (S9-R3).”
  • S2-R6: “Before a manual order is saved, use the List’s default work order sort, ties included, exactly as the List sorts today: work orders for the same customer go by start date, newest first. The List itself does not change. A work order that gets a new lead after it was created goes to the bottom of that technician’s work instead (S9-R14).”

Last checked against build v26.43.5-77de68c (production) on 11/2/2026.
